title: sec: download helper has no scheme/host allowlist on the output redirect (SSRF/file:// /open-follower)
description: verify_webhook is fine, but download_output_stream resolves the 302 Location from GET /v1/jobs/{id}/output and passes it straight to urllib.request.urlopen, which (a) accepts file://, ftp://, internal/private hosts and the cloud-metadata IP, and (b) uses the default opener so it will follow further redirects to any host. Platform protocol requires: follow exactly one redirect and only to allowlisted hosts (*.backblazeb2.com). Fix in sophon_sdk/helpers/downloads.py: validate the resolved URL is https and host is allowlisted; do not follow a second redirect.
close_reason: Download helper now validates the presigned URL (https + allowlisted host) and follows exactly one redirect; covered by tests/test_download_security.py

title: sec: debug mode leaks Authorization: Bearer header to stdout (generated configuration.py)
description: Configuration.debug=True sets httplib.HTTPConnection.debuglevel=1, so http.client (under urllib3) prints 'send:' lines including the Authorization: Bearer <key> header. Verified: debug=True -> debuglevel==1. Checklist (published SDKs): default logger must never include Authorization, even at DEBUG. Opt-in and standard OpenAPI-Generator behavior. configuration.py is GENERATED (DO NOT EDIT) — durable fix belongs in the upstream Liqhtworks/sophon-api generator template (redact Authorization/X-Api-Key in the debug dump). Parity with sophon-sdk-go-bqk. Tracked here; left OPEN for upstream.

title: wait_for_job on_progress leaks JobStatus enum on live API (Fix 7 regression)
description: The v0.1.5 audit claimed wait_for_job 'normalizes job.status to a plain string before invoking on_progress (Go SDK parity)'. Behavioral test against api.liqhtworks.xyz proves on_progress receives <JobStatus.QUEUED: 'queued'> (a str-subclass Enum), not a plain str. JobsApi.get_job returns a JobResponse pydantic whose status field is typed as JobStatus enum; _normalize_status (helpers/jobs.py:125-141) explicitly skips pydantic typed-enum fields. Reproducer: sophon-sdk-python-test/test_audit_fixes.py::test_live_fix7_on_progress_sees_string_status. Fix options: (a) special-case str-Enum in _normalize_status to use .value, (b) detect pydantic v2 model field types via __pydantic_fields__ and re-validate after coercion, (c) document this as expected and update the claim. Note: TypeScript and Go SDKs pass plain strings, so this is a real cross-SDK parity gap.
close_reason: Fixed in helpers/jobs.py:_normalize_status. Root cause: isinstance(status, str) returned True for JobStatus(str, Enum) members, short-circuiting the coercion. Changed to type(status) is str so the enum path now reaches object.__setattr__(job, 'status', enum.value). Verified live: on_progress now receives plain str for all 3 transitions (probing/muxing/completed). 29/29 behavioral + 41/41 stub tests pass.
